segment.source: Hugo, where are you?<end>
segment.target: Hugo, where are you?<end>

segment.source: Please, I'm in the middle of a conversation. ::Coughs.::<end>
segment.target: Please, I'm in the middle of a conversation. ::Coughs.::<end>

segment.source:
::The woman turns to you the instant you enter the room. Her eyebrows raise, and so do the corners of her lips to form a smile, a smile that lasts as long as a hopper in burrower nest. As soon as she realizes you are not the one she has been expecting, it collapses with a thud.::
Hugo, is that-- Oh... ::She coughs.:: How may I help you?<end>
segment.target:
::The woman turns to you the instant you enter the room. Her eyebrows raise, and so do the corners of her lips to form a smile, a smile that lasts as long as a hopper in burrower nest. As soon as she realizes you are not the one she has been expecting, it collapses with a thud.::
Hugo, is that-- Oh... ::She coughs.:: How may I help you?<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: About Hugo...<end>
segment.target: About Hugo...<end>

segment.source: What about him?<end>
segment.target: What about him?<end>

segment.source: You know who I am and what I've done to help this station. You can trust me.<end>
segment.target: You know who I am and what I've done to help this station. You can trust me.<end>

segment.source: ::The woman barely refrains herself from crying.:: He... he came here with some people. He told me they were his friends. ::She stops to cough.:: They looked really suspicious and had this... foreboding presence. But Hu-Hugo claimed that he knew them from before and that it's okay to trust them. He also said they were gonna help him earn some money to pay off that damned debt, and then he left with them. Left... ::She coughs, after which her voice starts shaking.:: But he should have been back by now. He told me he'd return shortly! Something happened to him - I know it!<end>

segment.source: What is this debt you're talking about?<end>
segment.target: What is this debt you're talking about?<end>

segment.source: He owed some money to... certain "people." He never told me who they were, he simply referred to them as "some people" and told me not to worry. Like I can just switch it off whenever I wish, like a mine cart or something. But he kept convincing me it was no big deal, to relax, to... to... ::Tears begin rolling down her cheeks.:: Sometimes h-he'd be back home looking like he had seen, um, seen a, a corpse. I'm only worried that he isn't one now...<end>

segment.source: I'll find him, but I have to ask you one more thing: Do you know where they left?<end>
segment.target: I'll find him, but I have to ask you one more thing: Do you know where they left?<end>

segment.source: ::She coughs.:: Hugo, he told me he was going outside of Foundry, nothing else, but one of our neighbors who got off the train at the time they were leaving said he saw them heading straight east from the entrance. Ah, who knows where he is and what has happened to him! Please, if you find him - bring him back. Please bring my Hugo back!<end>

segment.source: I'll see what I can do. Take care.<end>

segment.source: I'm off.<end>
segment.target: I'm off.<end>

segment.source: Tell me where they left.<end>
segment.target: Tell me where they left.<end>

segment.source: So Hugo was quite a gambler, I presume.<end>

segment.source: ::She nods.:: <end>
segment.target: ::She nods.:: <end>

segment.source: ::[Intimidate]:: It'll be healthier for you if you just told me where he is. Trust me.<end>
